component.name: Emulsion
component.summary: Edit photos and paint with layers and branchable history

description.p: Emulsion edits photographs and paintings with layers, masks, adjustment nodes and a history you can branch. Brushes behave like their medium, recipes recreate film and camera looks, and camera RAW and Photoshop files open directly. Every AI feature is optional: local models for selection, matting, fill, depth, upscaling and face restoration, an image server of your own for generative fill, and a coding assistant that drives the same commands you do.
